title: The Vault in the Alps
teaser: A blue lake, a vault that only opens for blood, and a choice on the mountain that someone won't come back from.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Geneva. A lake so blue it looks painted, and a fountain throwing water a hundred and forty metres into the sky.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Banque Moreau is a grey stone building with no sign on the door.

lines.speaker: elise
lines.text: Welcome. Elise Moreau. I was so sorry to hear about Mr Ashworth. London is a dangerous city.

lines.speaker: elise
lines.text: And Monsieur Balogun. How nice to see a familiar face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every head turns toward Kolade.

lines.speaker: elise
lines.text: Chief Okoro's box requires his key and the blood of an Okoro. I'm afraid none of you qualify.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten floors underground, a round steel door older than the bank above it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The brass key turns. The vault doesn't open. Beside the lock is a small glass plate, the size of a fingertip.

lines.speaker: nabyen
lines.text: The blood of an Okoro...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nabyen presses her finger to the glass. A needle, a single drop of red, and the great door begins to turn.

lines.speaker: elise
lines.text: That's... impossible.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside: the second half of the will, half of a coral bracelet that matches Nabyen's exactly, and a ledger bound in black leather.

lines.speaker: letter
lines.text: To my daughter Nabyen, and to the three children I chose: the crown belongs to whoever you choose, together. Elise Moreau has robbed me for ten years. The proof is in this book. — G.O.

lines.speaker: elise
lines.text: Guards!

scenes.prompt: Elise Moreau's guards are pounding down the stairs.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Up the stairs, through the lobby, out into the sunlight with alarms screaming.

choices.text: Hold the vault door so the others can get out.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Steel against shoulder, ten seconds that feel like ten years. Long enough.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The mountain train to Zermatt. Snow, pines, and a red carriage crawling up the edge of the world.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Elise's men are two carriages behind them.

lines.speaker: hadiza
lines.text: There's a footpath from the next station down to the police post at Täsch. Steep, and in this weather, deadly.

lines.speaker: hadiza
lines.text: One person carries the ledger down. The rest of us lead them up the mountain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kolade is texting. Elise's men know exactly which carriage they're in.

scenes.prompt: Who carries the ledger down the mountain?

choices.text: Tari. He's the strongest of us.
Hadiza. She knows exactly what the ledger proves.

response.speaker: hadiza
response.text: Page by page. Don't wait for me.

response.speaker: kolade
response.text: Finally, a job that pays in glory.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: {pov} zips the ledger into a coat pocket and steps off the train into the white.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The storm comes in off the Matterhorn like the end of the world.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tari reaches the police post at Täsch with the ledger inside his jacket. The police find two bullets in him, and not one in the ledger.

lines.speaker: tari
lines.text: Tell Nabyen... I owe her... a fish...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tari Ebiowei, Prince of the Creeks, dies in the snow, very far from the river.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hadiza reaches the police post at Täsch an hour after dark, the ledger dry and every page in order. Then she sits down in the snow and doesn't get up.

lines.speaker: hadiza
lines.text: Count it... properly... all of it...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hadiza Lawan, the sharpest mind in Kano, dies with the numbers balanced.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kolade reaches the police post at Täsch running on pride and nothing else. Elise's men reach it a minute later.

lines.speaker: kolade
lines.text: Tell Lagos... I earned it...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kolade Balogun dies with his phone still recording. The recording is enough to convict Elise twice over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Swiss police arrest Elise Moreau at her chalet before midnight. Her lawyers arrive by breakfast. It won't help her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {pov} carries the ledger down alone. Frostbitten, half-blind, alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But by the time the police reach the chalet, Elise Moreau is gone. Everyone else came down the mountain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The others know now what Kolade did. Elise made sure of it, out of spite.

choices.text: Lean close to the glass. "Hello, Le Loup." Watch the mask slip.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: By the time her lawyers arrive, Elise Moreau has confessed to everything. The poison. The spoon. Oliver.

choices.text: Hand everything to the Swiss courts. Let the law have her.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Elise Moreau will spend the next twenty years looking at a very small piece of Swiss sky.

choices.text: Offer Elise a deal: return every franc, and she walks.

response.speaker: elise
response.text: You're more like him than you know.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Forty million dollars comes home. The woman who stole it walks free.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Somewhere, a woman with pale hair is buying a ticket to somewhere warm.

choices.text: Let her go. You have the truth, and everyone is alive.

response.speaker: narrator
response.text: Everyone is alive. In this story, that's the rarest treasure of all.

outcomes.title: The Prince Falls
outcomes.text: Tari carried the ledger down the mountain and gave his life for it. The creeks will sing about him for a hundred years.

outcomes.title: The Last Ledger
outcomes.text: Hadiza carried the proof down the mountain, every page in order. Kano has lost its sharpest mind.

outcomes.title: The Banker's Debt
outcomes.text: Kolade wanted to earn it. On the mountain, he paid in full.

outcomes.title: Alone on the Mountain
outcomes.text: You carried it yourself. Everyone lived. Elise escaped. Every choice has a price.

reflections.text: Ten seconds at the vault door. The others won't forget them.
The money came home. Justice didn't.

s_wolf.title: Le Loup
s_wolf.text: WOLF. In Banque Moreau's private files, Elise signed every stolen transfer 'Le Loup'. The wolf.

m_geneva.title: The Blue Lake
m_geneva.text: A fountain touching the sky, and a bank with no sign.

m_vault.title: Blood and Steel
m_vault.text: One drop of red, and a door that remembered who her father was.

m_storm_alps.title: The Storm on the Pass
m_storm_alps.text: Somebody didn't come back down the mountain.

k_coral_whole.title: The coral bracelet, whole
k_coral_whole.text: Two halves, thirty years apart. A perfect fit.
